text:
lia: Heads-up — Atlas Health CISO just escalated. They want an exec bridge today. Blocking items from their security review: SCIM provisioning for Okta + delegated-admin, explicit EU data residency guarantee, and a completed security questionnaire (they asked for pen-test evidence). They also need a pricing floor for a 3-month POC with a throughput SLA. Can we assemble owners? @katy @omar :eyes:
omar: On it. I can scope SCIM work and confirm whether we can support delegated-admin for their IdP. ETA for a short doc: 3pm PT today. I can also spin up a dedicated pilot env in eu-west-1 if we get legal sign-off.
sanjay: I'll own the POC throughput SLA and run a quick perf check. What TPS and avg latency targets are they asking for?
lia: CISO said target is 150 reqs/sec sustained with 99th pct 200ms for text-gen routes. They said they'd like a short runbook for failover.
katy: I'll take exec bridge. Can we do 4:30pm PT? I need a one-slide cost model for the 3-month pilot and a clear ask for credits. lia, please confirm the stakeholders we'll invite (name + title).
tina: Legal here — send the security questionnaire PDF and any SOC2 / pen-test artifacts. We can pre-review for anything that needs redaction. Also need to confirm data residency wording we can commit to in the pilot contract.
lia: Stakeholders: Atlas — Priya Mehta (CISO), Carlos Ruiz (Head of Infra), Jenna Lowe (VP Product). I'll DM you their emails. Exec bridge 4:30pm PT works.
omar: Quick note on delegated-admin: we can offer SCIM with limited provisioning scope (users + groups) but not full delegated-admin ACLs without an engineering change. I can draft the scope and an alternative: run a lightweight SCIM proxy for the POC.
sanjay: For perf, I'll run a synthetic with the customer's sample traffic tomorrow morning. I need a test token and sample payloads. lia can you confirm sample size?
lia: Asking Atlas for sample payloads now. Also asked for the specific security questionnaire version — they referenced "SecurityReqs-v3".
ops-bot: incident created: INC-7821 — "Atlas Health POC: security + SCIM + SLA exec bridge". Assigned: infra-runbook, se-oncall.
katy: Good. For pricing, propose two options on the slide: 1) metered hosted with standard token pricing + 20% pilot discount, 2) reserved pilot capacity (committed GPUs) with flat monthly. Include a runway cost for autoscaling to meet 150TPS.
lia: +1. I'll draft the slide and share in this thread by 2:45pm PT. Can someone confirm SOC2 artifact location?
tina: SOC2 docs are in Confluence > Compliance > SOC2-2025-redacted. I'll pull the relevant pages and attach. Also: pen-test report requires NDA sharing. Lia — please add a note to request the customer's pen-test scope so we can validate alignment.
omar: If they require packet-capture or network-level testing we should route that through eng-telemetry, not the pilot env. Might need a separate signed addendum.
katy: I'll push for the addendum during the exec bridge if needed. Lia, please prepare an explicit ask: 1) trial credits 2) right to run perf tests 3) contact for pen-test artifacts.
lia: Will do. Sharing preliminary slide + the SCIM scope doc in ~45m.
katy: Thanks team. Let's aim to have legal + SE on the bridge. If we get an OK from Tina, we can present a conditional EU residency commitment for the POC. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled 2025-11-12T16:30:00-07:00 (Atlas Health Exec Bridge).
lia: Meeting invite sent to stakeholders and internal owners. Closing the loop here; will post updates once I have the questionnaire and sample payloads. :white_check_mark:
